|game_text="Device" on [[Harvest (V){{!}}Harvest]] may be treated as "[A New Hope] or [Hoth] droid". While at a farm: your characters present are forfeit +3; may raise this site (if converted) to the top; and, once per move phase, may put hand in Used Pile to place a 'crop' on Reserve Deck.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1, the current text (version 2 of 2). No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB4-69-Lars_Protocol_Droid-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 10 November 2026); the release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text (see [[Lars' Protocol Droid]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Lars' Protocol Droid]]): Virtual Block 4 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009 (slip 69)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; copy re-made 20 April 2010, first printing not found). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “"Device" on Harvest may be treated as "[A New Hope] or [Hoth] droid." While at a farm: your characters present are forfeit +3; may raise this site (if converted) to the top; and, once per move phase, may put hand in Used Pile to place a 'crop' on Reserve Deck.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-69-Lars_Protocol_Droid.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-L-larsprotocoldroid-pre.gif]]) print it. The Master List (Light Side p. 10)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> reprints it character for character: a stale reprint, not a new version, and it does not make this text current again.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC website card list, Virtual Block 4 list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1240_71">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock4Type (Virtual Block 4 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001437/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 12 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111144021/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “"Device" on Harvest may be treated as "[A New Hope] or [Hoth] droid". While at a farm: your characters present are forfeit +3; may raise this site (if converted) to the top; and, once per move phase, may put hand in Used Pile to place a 'crop' on Reserve Deck.” '''What changed:''' The full stop after “droid” moves outside the closing quote mark (“droid.” becomes “droid”.). The same wording is already in the Players Committee's Holotable card data of 29 May 2010<ref name="cdf-1240_71">[https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/5047de0/db/lightside.cdf Holotable card data file, version 29 May 2010] (Players Committee data, copy on GitHub). Card data is dating evidence only, not a card document.</ref>. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes.
